high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "naghma.rizwan," posted 10 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a striking vertical composition with a vibrant orange and yellow gradient dominating the center, suggesting a sunrise or sunset scene. The gradient is smooth and transitions into a darker blue at the bottom, indicating the sky and possibly the horizon. On the left side of the image, there is a silhouette of a cityscape, which includes numerous buildings of varying heights and shapes.
